Class CargoHold

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytruckerproject.model.tiles.Tile
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytruckerproject.model.tiles.CargoHold
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Cloneable
Direct Known Subclasses:
CargoBlue, CargoRed
public abstract class CargoHold extends Tile
Represents a cargo hold tile on a ship. It can store a certain number of goods, and optionally support hazardous goods (RED) if the hazard flag is set to true.
